'''''The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]]. It is the seventh installment of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'', and it was first published in [[April]] [[2007]] by [[Scholastic]].
